units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Snh. V, 3</cite> <he>בחמש</he> (sub. <cite ref="U01645"><he>שעות</he></cite>) during the fifth hour of the day.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>בחמשה</he> (sub. <he>ימים</he>) on the fifth of the month.—
B. Mets. IV, 9 תשלומי ארבעה וח׳ fines of the fourfold or fivefold value (Ex. XXI, 37); a. v. fr.—Pl. חֲמִשִּׁים (נ׳) fifty.
Ab. V, 21 בן ח׳ at the age of fifty years; a. v. fr.—Denom. חִמֵּשׁ to divide into five.—Part. pass. מְחוּמָּשׁ; f. מְחוּמֶּשֶׁת, pl. מְחוּמָּשׁוֹת.
B. Bath. 150ᵃ ובלבד שיהו מח׳ provided the minimum of wool required is equally divided between the five lambs.—חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה f.; חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר m. (ט״ו) fifteen.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:15">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>וחמשים</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 13:18">Ex. XIII, 18</cite>) <he>בח׳ ע׳ מיני וכ׳</he> with fifteen kinds of arms.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:8">Taan. IV, 8</cite> <he>כח׳ ע׳ באב</he> like the celebration of the fifteenth of Ab; a. fr.—Constr. of <cite ref="H01232"><he>חֲמִשָּׁה</he></cite>; <he>חֲמֵשֶׁת</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 30a:7">Kidd. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ אלפים</he> five thousand; a. fr.
